verses.html: A Psalm or Song for the sons of Korah. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.text: A Psalm or Song for the sons of Korah. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.title: A Psalm or Song for the sons of Korah.
verses.titleHtml: A Psalm or Song for the sons of Korah.

verses.html: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.text: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.html: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
verses.text: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

verses.html: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
verses.text: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

verses.html: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.text: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

verses.html: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
verses.text: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

verses.html: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
verses.text: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
